s: Who among the following dynasties founded the Kingdom of Berar?
x:
The Imad Shahi dynasty was one of the five Deccan Sultanates that emerged after the decline of the Bahmani Sultanate. It was founded by Fathullah Imad-ul-Mulk in 1490 CE, with Ellichpur (Achalpur) as its capital. After the Bahmani kingdom weakened due to internal conflicts and provincial revolts, several governors declared independence. The five successor states were: • Ahmadnagar – Nizam Shahis • Bijapur – Adil Shahis • Berar – Imad Shahis • Bidar – Barid Shahis • Golconda – Qutb Shahis The Kingdom of Berar remained independent until it was annexed by the Nizam Shahis of Ahmadnagar in 1574.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).

s: What was the main cause of conflict between the Bahmani and Vijayanagara kingdoms?
x:
The principal cause of the prolonged wars between the Bahmani Sultanate and the Vijayanagara Empire was the control of the fertile Raichur Doab (Raichur Antarvedi), the region lying between the Krishna and Tungabhadra rivers. The region was agriculturally rich and strategically important. Both kingdoms fought numerous battles over it, including the famous Battle of Raichur (1520), where Sri Krishnadevaraya defeated the Bijapur Sultan.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).
